title: Coverage-Loyalty Months (Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility Payment Arrangements)
content:
Coverage-loyalty months are added to the term of a new Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility payment arrangement according to the whole calendar months between the coverage record's effective date and the handling date.

| Whole calendar months since the coverage record's effective date | Months added |
|---|---|
| at least 60 | 2 |
| at least 24 but fewer than 60 | 1 |
| fewer than 24 | 0 |

Hypothetical records: a record effective 60 whole months ago adds 2; 59 months, 1; 24 months, 1; 23 months, none. The record read is the coverage record of the account on which the arrangement is set.
